name: Nagakute
tagline: Expo parkland and the home of Ghibli Park.
intro_en: Nagakute, just east of Nagoya, is home to the Aichi Expo Memorial Park, the site of the 2005 World Expo and now a vast green space of forest trails, lawns and play areas.

Within the park grounds is Ghibli Park, where scenes and buildings from Studio Ghibli films are recreated at full scale — Satsuki and Mei's house from My Neighbor Totoro among them. Tickets must be booked in advance for a specific date, so plan ahead rather than turning up on the day.
Beyond the park, the town is relaxed and residential, with plenty of space to breathe — an easy half-day escape from the city.
getting_there_en: Take the Higashiyama subway line to Fujigaoka, then change to the Linimo maglev line for Ai·Chikyuhaku-Kinen-Koen Station.
